# Base test: functional diversity in `FD` and `fundiversity`

```r
library(fundiversity)
library(FD)
data(traits_birds)
data(site_sp_birds)
matrix <- traits_birds
abundance <- site_sp_birds
```

Let's first calculate the overall functional diversity metrics, ignoring abundance

```r
## FD results
FD_metrics <- FD::dbFD(traits_birds)
FD_metrics <- c(FRic = unname(FD_metrics$FRic),
                FEve = unname(FD_metrics$FEve),
                FDiv = unname(FD_metrics$FDiv),
                FDis = unname(FD::fdisp(dist(traits_birds))$FDis),
                RaoQ = unname(FD_metrics$RaoQ))

## Fundiversity results
fundiversity_metrics <- c(FRic = fd_fric(traits_birds)[,2],
                          FEve = fd_feve(traits_birds)[,2],
                          FDiv = fd_fdiv(traits_birds)[,2],
                          FDis = fd_fdis(traits_birds)[,2],
                          RaoQ = fd_raoq(traits_birds)[,2])

cbind(FD_metrics[-1], fundiversity_metrics[-1])

## disparity results?

# FRic ref: Villéger, S., Mason, N.W.H., Mouillot, D., 2008: = convex hull volume in fundiversity?
# FEve ref: Villéger, S., Mason, N.W.H., Mouillot, D., 2008: 
# FDiv ref: Villéger S., Mason N. W. H., Mouillot D. (2008)
# FDis ref: Laliberté, E., & Legendre, P. (2010)
# RaoQ ref: Pavoine S., Dolédec S. (2005)

dispRity_metrics <- c(FRic = func.rich(traits_birds), ## Same as fundiversity # different from FD
                      FEve = func.eve(traits_birds),  ## Same as fundiversity # different from FD
                      FDiv = func.div(traits_birds),  ## Same as fundiversity # different from FD 
                      FDis = fd_fdis(traits_birds)[,2], 
                      RaoQ = fd_raoq(traits_birds)[,2])


microbenchmark(fd_fric(traits_birds), func.rich(traits_birds))
microbenchmark(fd_feve(traits_birds), func.eve(traits_birds))
microbenchmark(fd_fdiv(traits_birds), func.div(traits_birds))


## Reinvent the wheel:
matrix <- traits_birds
abundance <- matrix(sample(0:4, size = nrow(matrix), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.04, 0.24, 0.24, 0.24, 0.24)), ncol = 1, dimnames = list(rownames(matrix)))

# FRic = convhull.volume * abundance

# FEve = regularity of the species along it's minimum spanning tree * abundance

# FDiv = Weighted deviations from the distance of the convex hull center


```
